## 🎯 Program Overview

**Duration:** 23 Weeks (~5.5 Months)
**Format:** 2 × 1.5h lectures/week (Theory + Walkthrough) + 4–6 hrs/week practice
**Outcome:** Capstone-ready ML practitioner with theory-based modeling skills, practical pipelines, and a professional portfolio.
